answers.q1: Maven, via the committed Maven wrapper (./mvnw; Maven is the CI build, and build.gradle is a parallel Gradle build). Install/resolve dependencies with: ./mvnw -B dependency:go-offline
answers.q4: ./mvnw -B validate (runs the spring-javaformat validate goal and the nohttp checkstyle check, both bound to the validate phase; CI runs the full ./mvnw -B verify, which includes these)
answers.q5: src/main/resources/static/resources/css/petclinic.css is generated from src/main/scss/*.scss (via the Maven 'css' profile, ./mvnw generate-resources -P css), so change the SCSS and regenerate instead of editing the CSS. src/main/resources/static/resources/fonts/* and the bundled webfont assets are vendored third-party files. target/ and build/ are build output and not hand-edited.
